reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per activation event on 26 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS prev_ts
  FROM activation_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-26 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-27 00:00:00+00'
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per activation event on 26 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
)
SELECT user_id, SUM(new_session) AS sessions
FROM flagged
GROUP BY user_id

WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per activation event on 26 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_name) AS prev_ts
  FROM activation_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-26 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-27 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes') AS sessions
FROM gaps
GROUP BY user_id

WITH day_events AS (
  -- one row per activation event on 26 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name
  FROM activation_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-26 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-27 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT e.user_id,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM day_events p
    WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
      AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_name < e.event_name))
      AND p.event_ts >= e.event_ts - INTERVAL '30 minutes')) AS sessions
FROM day_events e
GROUP BY e.user_id

  -- one row per activation event on 26 October 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT user_id, event_ts, event_name
  FROM activation_events
  WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-26 00:00:00+00'
    AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-27 00:00:00+00'
)
SELECT e.user_id,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM day_events p
    WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
      AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_name < e.event_name))
      AND p.event_ts >= e.event_ts - INTERVAL '30 minutes')) AS sessions
FROM day_events e
GROUP BY e.user_id
other_way.tradeoff: Counting the events with no earlier event of the user in the 30 minutes before works without LAG, but each event searches the day again.
